text:
Sam: Quick check — final pass on the company-level OKRs doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/okr-Q3. Need exec alignment before I lock for the board packet. please drop major block / vetos now.
Maria: skimmed — overall good. two asks: 1) Dedicated revenue target looks optimistic, can we split committed vs. expansion? 2) Need an explicit reliability SLA metric under Platform reliability (p99 < 120ms for hosted).
Alex: +1 on adding SLA. also propose making the 'New model onboarding' objective two phases: triage + GA. keeps expectations realistic.
Lee: engineering capacity is tight. current engineering KR for 'Reduce latency by 20%' needs clarification: is that per-token or tail? if tail p99 we need more time or scope down to 10% with better batching.
Jordan: from GTM — we need clearer launch criteria tied to Redwood Console readiness (traces + cost dashboard). customers will not accept GA without those. can we add a gating KR?
Olivia: finance wants the cost savings KR to map to $ numbers and time horizon. right now it's % savings but our FP&A needs $ delta for the commit. also flag: Dedicated ARR ramp assumption uses a single large deal in month 2 — risky.
Sam: solid points. proposed edits: split Dedicated revenue KR into Commit ARR and Expansion ARR (numbers in doc), change latency KR to 'p50 - 10% / p99 - 8% (within Q3 engineering window)' and add Console readiness gating KR (traces + cost dashboard). added dollarized cost savings for Optimize. link again: https://docs.internal/redwood/okr-Q3#edits
Maria: that feels reasonable. leaders can accept as long as Lee confirms engineering schedule.
Lee: ok, I can take the latency KR if we scope to selective models (hosted default model family) and disable the most exotic long-context workloads in this quarter. will add a short tech debt KR to account for extra infra work.
Jordan: GTM ok on gating KR. will align launch comms plan with dates after sign-off.
Olivia: finance accepts dollarized savings once we add conservative vs. upside columns — please add.
Sam: done — doc updated with conservative/upside columns and model-scope note. tagging @Maria for final sign-off.
Maria: approved. :thumbsup:
Alex: approving on product side. :thumbsup:
Lee: approved from eng with the scoped caveat. :thumbsup:
Jordan: approved for GTM. :thumbsup: :rocket:
Olivia: approved (finance). please don't bake in that single large-deal ARR. :eyes:
OKRBot: Summary: all exec approvals recorded. status -> READY_FOR_BOARD. recorded 6 approvals.
Sam: thanks all. locking the doc and moving to board materials. if anyone has late concerns open a thread in #product; otherwise closing. :white_check_mark:
